project.name: TaskerKeeper Harness Sidebars
project.description: Sidebar integrations for OpenCode, Pi/oh-my-pi, OpenChamber, and Paseo, all driven by one shared payload builder over cli.py: current, concurrent, upcoming with details, then phase tree, then overall tree, each cut to room.

phases.title: Shared core
phases.goal: One budgeted payload builder plus a sidebar CLI command so every harness adapter shells out to the same source instead of reimplementing the DAG.

tasks.title: Sidebar payload builder and CLI command
tasks.goal: Create taskerkeeper/sidebar.py with sidebar_payload() (current in_progress with claim age and goal, concurrent disjoint set, upcoming ready plus top blocked, current-phase tree, overall phase tree, all truncated to width/height with more-counts) and render_sidebar() text form. Wire taskerkeeper sidebar <file> [--json] [--width] [--height] in cli.py. All scheduling calls delegate to existing cli functions.
success: sidebar --json returns current, concurrent, upcoming, phase_tree, overall sections
text render fits width and height budgets with more-counts
tasks.changelog: Added budgeted sidebar payload and CLI command

phases.title: Harness adapters
phases.goal: Thin sidebar panels for each harness, all consuming the sidebar command output. Read-only, privacy-safe (no secrets, no absolute paths).

tasks.title: OpenCode TUI sidebar plugin
tasks.goal: Create integrations/opencode/ TUI plugin registering sidebar_content slot in the public TUI plugin style (opencode-harness-panel pattern): collapsible TaskerKeeper block rendering current, concurrent, upcoming, phase tree, overall tree from taskerkeeper sidebar output polled on render. Read-only, basename paths only.
success: plugin loads via tui.json tuple form
renders all five sections with more-counts when tight

tasks.title: Pi extension sidebar panel
tasks.goal: Create integrations/pi/ extension in pi-sidebar-tui style (pi manifest field, event hooks, panels/taskerkeeper panel, /tk-sidebar toggle): same five sections from sidebar command output. Must also load under oh-my-pi omp, which shares the Pi extension API.
success: extension registers via pi package field
toggle command works, panel renders five sections
tasks.tests: documented manual load in pi and omp

tasks.title: OpenChamber rail extension
tasks.goal: Create integrations/openchamber/ extension (package.json openchamber manifest, panel/index.html, panel/main.js IIFE built for sandbox iframe via openchamber-guest-bundle): rail panel with current, concurrent, upcoming, phase tree, overall tree plus attach support for tasks. Reads TaskerKeeper serve API through an integration apiOrigin; panel-only reading needs no capability.
success: manifest validates against OpenChamber extension shape
panel builds to single IIFE, renders five sections from serve API

tasks.title: Paseo plugin sidebar and panel
tasks.goal: Create integrations/paseo/ plugin (addSidebarItem nav entry plus addWorkspacePanel tab, server handle RPC spawning the sidebar command): same five sections, working across Paseo clients.
success: sidebar item and workspace panel register
panel renders five sections via server RPC
tasks.tests: documented manual load via paseo plugin scaffold shape
tasks.changelog: Added Paseo sidebar and workspace panel

phases.title: Docs and release
phases.goal: Document the sidebar command and all four integrations, bump to 0.7.0.

tasks.title: Docs sync and 0.7.0 release
tasks.goal: Add sidebar row to README commands table, SKILL.md usage, integration-guide harness section, CHANGELOG 0.7.0 entry, bump pyproject and __init__ versions together.
success: every new command and integration path documented
